Summary.SummarizedSegment: Right lower jaw pain
The patient presents with pain at the back of the mouth on the lower right side that has been present for approximately one week.
They describe the pain as a dull ache most of the time, which becomes sharp when chewing on that side.
Additionally, the patient reports swelling of the gum behind the last tooth on the bottom right, which is tender when touched with the tongue.
They also note a slightly bad taste in the mouth at times.
The patient denies fever or difficulty opening the mouth.
They report a similar episode approximately one year ago that resolved on its own after a few days.
